issues.quote: Some green chaos spun around me and caught the carriage by all its wheels
At last we are home. The white walls of the house restore my senses. The moment the carriage rolled into the wide green yard
Then suddenly I heard a great silence.
lay in the deep blue spaces
filled with darkness to the brim
as if afraid the lamplight will all leak out through the cracks
Quiet and empty, and yet I hear something there, beyond my wall.
sunk at the bottom of the black darkness
and the creak of the floor under its weight
drown in the black darkness myself
into "nothing." How good it would be to become "nothing,"
And yet there, beyond my wall, something is there.
if I were to walk into the dark rooms like this
everything would leap at once into its place: chairs, sofas, windows, even cornices

strengths.quote: my eyes drowned in it as in a sea and searched for something to catch hold of
It was so quiet that I felt ashamed of the pounding of my own heart.
I close the door, as if afraid the lamplight will all leak out through the cracks.
Well, stay where you are, rest in peace.
all those who left their faces in the mirrors, their voices in the cracks and corners, their shapes in the soft horsehair stuffing of the furniture, and their shadows on the walls
Who knows what goes on where a person cannot see...
